subject: design/implement-now-issue-entry
statement: Add a closed `issue-execution-summary/v1` record and a consumer-owned summary-publication capability on the existing code hosts. A host-owned marker in the PR body holds readable text and typed JSON; updates replace only that owned section, preserving the task association and authored body. Repeated publication is idempotent for the same proposal/contract/attempt summary.
